title: Give new workers a shortlist of the best super funds
action: Create a single 'best in show' shortlist of up to ten high-performing super products, chosen by an independent panel through a competitive process, for workers starting their first job, and default members only once so they do not collect duplicate accounts.
why: The performance test removes the worst funds, but defaults still steer many workers to funds chosen by their award or employer; a shortlist makes funds compete to be among the best.

evidence.quote: A single 'best in show' shortlist of up to 10 superannuation products should be presented to all members who are new to the workforce (or do not have a superannuation account), from which they can choose a product.
The Australian Government should establish an independent expert panel to run a competitive process to develop the 'best in show' shortlist.
